description: Falsifiable reach test of the depth-2 binding kernel R=x²−τx+1: does it predict the selection-rule values lw(4),lw(5) beyond its c≤3 anchors? lw(c)=(1/(c+1))Σ_{λ⊢c+1} dim_q (canonical q-hook). No fit; τ from c≤3 anchors.
verdict: SCOPE-LIMITED NEGATIVE (a): the depth-2 *constant* kernel does NOT predict lw(c) beyond its c≤3 anchors — lw(4) misses by 0.0038170654 (rel), lw(5) by 0.13914441. τ is fixed by three anchors (det=1 + one ratio), so matching c≤3 is automatic; the c≥4 deviation shows the constant depth-2 kernel is anchor-limited, consistent with the corpus 'depth ≤ 3 constant kernel refuted; true object is non-constant/higher-depth' (2026-06-04-c4-gap-no-constant-kernel-recursion.md). NOT a structural exclusion: the proved λ₊>1 extensive-growth property (PR #2718) stands; this only bounds the constant-kernel reach. No fit; q₀ only as evaluation point.
